title: ApprovedFillBatch
description: Authorization grant generated exclusively upon explicit user confirmation in the extension UI. Entitles the Content Script to fill only the specified fields on the target form instance.

batchId.description: Unique cryptographic identifier generated when user clicks 'Approve & Fill'.

tabId.description: Chrome browser tab ID where authorization was granted.

origin.description: Web origin authorized for this batch (e.g., https://portal.example.com). Insertion into any other origin is strictly blocked.

formInstanceId.description: Form snapshot ID for which this batch was authorized. Re-rendering or DOM replacement invalidates this token.

approvedTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of explicit user approval action.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which this authorization batch is considered expired and non-executable.

approvedFields.description: Explicit list of field-value pairs verified and confirmed by the user. Only fields in this array will be inserted.

fieldId.description: Opaque field ID to be populated.

approvedValue.description: The exact value approved by the user for insertion. Checkboxes must be booleans; dropdowns must match allowed options.

userModified.description: Flag indicating whether the user edited the proposed value in the staging UI before approving.

expectedDomPathHash.description: Structural hash verified against the live DOM node immediately prior to insertion.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the approved batch.
